name: Cearnach

attributes.attribute: bearer of the cognomen written Cearnach in modern spelling

text: Cearnach is the modern spelling of the old cognomen Cemach. The bearer is Conall Cernach, the famed Ulster hero. Modern writers render his byname in this present-day form. The word marks the same warrior whom the Ulster tales celebrate.

okr.objective: Cearnach is the modern spelling of the cognomen of the Ulster hero Conall Cernach.
key_results: Cearnach is the modern spelling of the old cognomen Cemach.
The cognomen belongs to Conall Cernach.
Conall Cernach stands among the heroes of Ulster.
